text: This report provides information and identifies a preliminary set of issues regarding the application located at 145-155 Balmoral Avenue. Staff is currently reviewing the application. It has been circulated to all appropriate agencies and City divisions for comment. A community consultation meeting was held on March 20, 2019.

The Toronto and East York Community Council directed: 1. Additional mailing costs resulting from an expanded notification area for the community consultation meeting held on March 20, 2019 beyond 120 metres of the site be borne by the applicant.
